baseline.observed: Exact public 390px place pages showed Red Hill in 12 photographs with two Merricks North Jackalope photos; Mornington in 18 with two Bass & Flinders photos captioned Mornington; Merricks in 12, with four Merricks North Rare Hare images in source gallery; Main Ridge in 7, all seven Shoreham Ocean Eight photos. Mornington guide called the Wednesday Main Street artisan market a farmers market on the Esplanade, and its best day said Sunday market. Bass & Flinders venue record gave old 232 Balnarring Road, Tuerong and wrong phone. Four inspected venue Get directions links prioritised coordinates that resolved away from their official addresses; Ocean Eight also had wrong phone. Independent review also found Main Ridge Estate and Kooyong wrongly carded under Main Ridge despite Red Hill/Red Hill South operator addresses, Red Hill Estate carded under Red Hill despite its Main Ridge address, an Endota directions pin and contact details that disagreed with its operator, and a linked market article recommending 3 October Hill & Ridge even after the organiser posted a cancellation. Further independent review found the Main Ridge CMS hero had no visible attribution; all four town heroes lost their mobile text gutter; Red Hill linked a cancelled 3 October market, and the markets guide still called it confirmed. Exact town-card labels also contradicted operator/postal localities for Avani, Epicurean, Many Little, Elgee, Scorpo, Spa by Jackalope, Willow Creek and Phaedrus. Kerri Greens' public cellar door had closed; the Elgee Park estate is closed to general visitors. Many Little and Phaedrus had materially wrong visitor directions and phone details. The Merricks North receiving page still recommended an Elgee Park estate cellar-door visit and called Baillieu/Stonier Merricks North local stops, while the operators place their public tastings in Merricks. Its visible CMS cover had no usable attribution and the JSON fallback was a temporary Unsplash placeholder.
